### From `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

#### <a id="core-connectdecl"></a>`ConnectDecl`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

A system's `connect` declaration: its page, how to connect, the per-person settings and the fns that act as the person.

```ts
type ConnectDecl = {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  how: {
    flow: "oauth";
  } | {
    flow: "form";
    form: TypeDef$1<any>;
  };
  settings: TypeDef$1<any>;
  fns: Record<string, {
    on: boolean;
    ask: boolean;
  }>;
  icon?: string | undefined;
  scope?: "instance" | "system" | "key" | undefined;
  keys?: {
    type: `${string}/${string}`;
  } | undefined;
  defaults?: {
    on: boolean;
    ask: boolean;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-connectfinish"></a>`ConnectFinish`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

Hub → system: the redirect came back (its query `params`) or the form was sent (`form`); answer the account and credentials.

```ts
type ConnectFinish = {
  connection: string;
  owner: string;
  redirect: string;
  answer: {
    params: Record<string, string>;
  } | {
    form: z.core.util.JSONType;
  };
  instance?: InstanceName | undefined;
  key?: ConnectKey | undefined;
};
```

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

type ConnectStart = {
  connection: string;

#### <a id="core-fnconnectkey"></a>`FnConnectKey`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

A fn's connection key, for a key-scoped system: a fixed key (an api fn's service, from its kind's description), or the
arg whose value names it (a fn that takes the service to act on).

```ts
type FnConnectKey = ConnectKey | {
  arg: string;
};
```

#### <a id="core-instanceconnect"></a>`InstanceConnect`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

Build 9: how people connect to one instance of an instance-scoped system (`instanceConnect` on the hub link, sent
whenever its config changes). `flow` absent: its calls need no connection (shared credentials, or none).
`share`: an admin's single connection is used by everyone (a shared OAuth sign-in), rather than each person's own.

```ts
type InstanceConnect = {
  share: boolean;
  title: string;
  flow?: {
    flow: "oauth";
  } | {
    flow: "form";
    form: TypeDef$1<any>;
  } | undefined;
};
```

#### <a id="core-runconnection"></a>`RunConnection`

const, type · declared in `packages/core/src/connections.ts`

What a run that acts as a person carries (`RunRequest.connection`): the connection and its revealed credentials.

```ts
type RunConnection = {
  id: string;
  owner: string;
  credentials: z.core.util.JSONType;
  settings: z.core.util.JSONType;
};
```
